metadata.description: Epoch-one per-run lifecycle outcome marker. This owner-written record is separate from the current-run freshness state and from the CLI report payload.
Reserved domain run ID. The owner validates exactly 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters and compares it with the reservation and the derived marker filename.
Opaque sha256:<64-lowerhex> digest of the exact C.1 namespace, scope, key, canonical request and plan, and reserved run binding. It is a comparison value, never an effect grant.
The lifecycle owner's actual result. A parked run is not terminal completion; an uncertain run never becomes success from a freshness header or EOF.
Effect truth independent of the outcome: a failed or parked run may already have landed effects.
SHA-256 of the exact persisted report bytes, checked after a no-follow bounded reread before this marker is committed.
Typed reason the owner cannot furnish a validated durable report payload. This never implies completed execution.
